messages.subject: sqldf function
parts:
Dear Concern,

I'm new to R world, I'm native user of SAS. I'm writing small piece of code using sqldf, I'm getting an error :Error: could not find function "sqldf".  

Can someone explain me where i made the mistake. I faced this kind of error for some other functions too.  I'm using R version 3.3.0.

Sample code:

# Load the package
library(sqldf)


# Use the titanic data set

data("iris", package="PASWR")
colnames(iris)
head(iris)

df=sqldf("select count(*) from iris  group by species")


Many thanks in advance.

Thank you
Satheesh
